decision: Fill the builder view with the canvas and open stage details in a Nessa UI drawer.
rationale: Explicit user clarification supersedes the permanently visible inspector. learning:aaccfa61-c663-8a0e-9d91-ac9783f96aab. Workflow settings and save preview also use drawers to keep the canvas full-view. Linear ordering and validation are unchanged.

discovery.observation: User requires full-view canvas with click-to-open detail drawers, rather than inline stage settings.
discovery.regression: Open a stage drawer, edit, close, and verify canvas stays full-view on narrow screens.
